question: For real numbers \( w \) and \( z ,\) \[ \cfrac{\frac{1}{w} + \frac{1}{z}}{\frac{1}{w} - \frac{1}{z}} = 2014. \] What is \( \frac{w+z}{w-z} ?\)
solution:
The reciprocals suggest multiplying both the numerator and denominator by \(wz\). The original expression is defined, so \(w\ne0\), \(z\ne0\), and \(1/w-1/z\ne0\). The last condition also gives \(w\ne z\).

Because \(wz\ne0\), this multiplication preserves the fraction and gives
\[
\frac{\frac1w+\frac1z}{\frac1w-\frac1z}
=\frac{z+w}{z-w}=2014.
\]
The requested numerator is the same, while its denominator has the opposite sign: \(w-z=-(z-w)\). Therefore
\[
\frac{w+z}{w-z}
=-\frac{w+z}{z-w}
=-2014.
\]
The answer is choice A.
